verbs.help: Bun is a fast JavaScript runtime, package manager, bundler, and test runner.

bun.help: Force a script or package to use Bun's runtime instead of Node.js (via symlinking node)

config.help: Specify path to Bun config file

console_depth.help: Set the default depth for console.log object inspection

cpu_prof.help: Start CPU profiler and write profile to disk on exit

cpu_prof_dir.help: Specify the directory where the CPU profile will be saved

cpu_prof_interval.help: Specify the sampling interval in microseconds for CPU profiling

cpu_prof_md.help: Output CPU profile in markdown format (grep-friendly, designed for LLM analysis)

cpu_prof_name.help: Specify the name of the CPU profile file

cron_period.help: Cron period for cron execution mode

cwd.help: Absolute path to resolve files & entry points from

dns_result_order.help: Set the default order of DNS lookup results

elide_lines.help: Number of lines of script output shown when using --filter

env_file.help: Load environment variables from the specified file(s)

experimental_http2_fetch.help: Offer h2 in fetch() TLS ALPN

experimental_http3_fetch.help: Honor Alt-Svc: h3 in fetch() and upgrade to HTTP/3

expose_gc.help: Expose gc() on the global object

fetch_preconnect.help: Preconnect to a URL while code is loading

filter.help: Run a script in all workspace packages matching the pattern

heap_prof.help: Generate V8 heap snapshot on exit (.heapsnapshot)

heap_prof_dir.help: Specify the directory where the heap profile will be saved

heap_prof_md.help: Generate markdown heap profile on exit (for CLI analysis)

heap_prof_name.help: Specify the name of the heap profile file

hot.help: Enable auto reload in the Bun runtime, test runner, or bundler

if_present.help: Exit without an error if the entrypoint does not exist

inspect_brk.help: Activate Bun's debugger, set breakpoint on first line of code and wait

inspect_wait.help: Activate Bun's debugger, wait for a connection before executing

max_http_header_size.help: Set the maximum size of HTTP headers in bytes

no_addons.help: Throw an error if process.dlopen is called, and disable export condition "node-addons"

no_clear_screen.help: Disable clearing the terminal screen on reload when --hot or --watch is enabled

no_deprecation.help: Suppress all reporting of the custom deprecation

no_exit_on_error.help: Continue running other scripts when one fails (with --parallel/--sequential)

no_install.help: Disable auto install in the Bun runtime

no_orphans.help: Exit when the parent process dies, and on exit SIGKILL every descendant

parallel.help: Run multiple scripts concurrently with Foreman-style output

port.help: Set the default port for Bun.serve

prefer_latest.help: Use the latest matching versions of packages in the Bun runtime, always checking npm

prefer_offline.help: Skip staleness checks for packages in the Bun runtime and resolve from disk

preload.help: Import a module before other modules are loaded

print.help: Evaluate argument as a script and print the result

revision.help: Print version with revision and exit

sequential.help: Run multiple scripts sequentially with Foreman-style output

shell.help: Control the shell used for package.json scripts

smol.help: Use less memory, but run garbage collection more often

throw_deprecation.help: Determine whether or not deprecation warnings result in errors

use_system_ca.help: Use the system's trusted certificate authorities

user_agent.help: Set the default User-Agent header for HTTP requests

watch.help: Automatically restart the process on file change

workspaces.help: Run a script in all workspace packages (from the "workspaces" field in package.json)

zero_fill_buffers.help: Boolean to force Buffer.allocUnsafe(size) to be zero-filled
